body.x: Synesso participated at CES 2023 in Las Vegas to reveal the espresso machine designed for personal use, ES1. Synesso built this machine for home baristas who want to deliver coffee with the technology of pro-level performance and features at home or in mobile settings.

Synesso collaborated with YES PLZ COFFEE, the online platform selling a unique blend of coffee roasted weekly. YES PLZ COFFEE says it sources its coffee from every part of the globe to discover a variety of combinations through experiments. After making a fresh release of coffee with quality control every week, it ships the blend to customers and subscribers. Here, Synesso demonstrated its product using YES PLZ's coffee - allowing visitors at CES 2023 to extract and brew their espresso shots.

body.cap: YES PLZ COFFEE featured its coffee with Synesso's machine. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: ES1 promises to bring capabilities of commercial espresso machines from café to the home or everywhere using low voltage, residential power while enduring high-volume repeatability. Synesso used high-quality stainless steel brew and steam tanks, heat-exchange coil, and dynamic proportional valves for this machine. Valves combine water paths then a heating coil adjusts heat precision every tenth of a second with logic technology - enabling simultaneous coffee brewing and steaming.

Synesso equipped Manual Volumetric Programming (MVP) tech from its commercial machines to ES1, allowing tight-tolerance control over extraction pressure, water flow, and volume. The MVP tech with the onboard pressure/flow graphing helps users to have better control over extraction pre-infusion, infusion, and ramp-down pressure with smooth pressure ramps between each stage.

body.cap: ES1's touch panel | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Furthermore, the machine stores brewing history like the web browser for comfortable brewing. After every shot extraction, the user can review and adjust the historical data before saving it as the formula with notes. The machine's detailed control panel on a touchscreen improves user experience while promising regular updates in its user interface and software.
